You: We talked about uh…{{wi}} The Old Testament…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: The Old Testament…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Is that right?
You: Y-yeah, the Old Testament.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Well, it’s pretty uncharacteristic of both of you. It’s pretty unfortunate that I wasn’t there to witness it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Which one of the books did you talk about?
You: Uh…
You: Oh, sorry, I don’t quite remember.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s a shame.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Shanice was reading the Gospel of Mark not so long ago, maybe that was the topic of your discussion?
You: Y-yeah, I think that was it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Oh really? The thing is the Gospel of Mark is actually a part of the New Testament. Shanice, since she’s a nun, wouldn’t make such a mistake.
I-it was a trap?!
You: I-I guess I made a mistake then, haha…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Certainly.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I won’t pry further into this, but I expected more honesty from you.
You…
